import sys,json,subprocess,random,importlib.util
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker, gen
rng=random.Random(99)
reqs=[gen.gen_request(rng) for _ in range(400)]
# add some larger-magnitude: scale demands/caps/budget
for r in reqs:
    for e in r["edges"]: e["capacity"]=rng.randint(500,1024)
    r["budget"]=rng.randint(0,98304)
data=b"".join((json.dumps(r)+"\n").encode() for r in reqs)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
maxineq=0;maxdual=0;maxmluL=0;maxmluopt=0;maxnorm=0;maxeq=0;maxcertcol=0;nopt=0;ninf=0
for req,o in zip(reqs,outs):
    B=checker.build(req)
    pres=checker.primal_opt(B)
    if o["status"]=="optimal":
        nopt+=1
        flows=o["flows"]; x=[]
        for k,c in enumerate(B["comms"]): x.extend(flows[k])
        x=np.array(x); a=B["a"]; t=np.abs(x-a); U=o["mlu"]
        v=np.concatenate([x,t,[U]])
        ineq=np.max(B["A"]@v-B["b"]) if B["A"].size else 0
        maxineq=max(maxineq,ineq)
        if B["E"].size:
            maxeq=max(maxeq,np.max(np.abs(B["E"]@v-B["d"])))
        y=np.array(o["dual"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(o["dual"]["equality"])
        col=B["A"].T@y+B["E"].T@q-B["c"]
        maxdual=max(maxdual,np.max(col) if col.size else 0)
        L=B["b"]@y+B["d"]@q if B["d"].size else B["b"]@y
        maxmluL=max(maxmluL,abs(o["mlu"]-L))
        maxmluopt=max(maxmluopt,abs(o["mlu"]-pres.fun))
    elif o["status"]=="infeasible":
        ninf+=1
        y=np.array(o["certificate"]["inequality"]);q=np.array(o["certificate"]["equality"])
        col=B["A"].T@y+B["E"].T@q
        maxcertcol=max(maxcertcol,np.max(col) if col.size else 0)
        val=B["b"]@y+(B["d"]@q if B["d"].size else 0)
        maxnorm=max(maxnorm,abs(val-1))
print("nopt",nopt,"ninf",ninf)
print("max primal ineq viol",maxineq)
print("max eq resid",maxeq)
print("max dual col viol",maxdual)
print("max |mlu-L|",maxmluL)
print("max |mlu-opt|",maxmluopt)
print("max cert col",maxcertcol)
print("max cert norm err",maxnorm)
PY
python metrics.py
